dashboardDesc: Real-time overview of storage capacity, recent stock movements, and operational metrics.
productsDesc: Manage inventory items, barcodes, SKU numbers, safety stock levels, and item specifications.
warehousesDesc: Configure physical warehouses, storage zones, aisles, and personnel assignments.
categoriesDesc: Organize catalog items into structured industry categories and classification groups.
unitsDesc: Standardize base counting, packaging, and conversion rules across product catalogs.
suppliersDesc: Maintain vendor contacts, procurement contracts, and supply chain partner information.
stockInDesc: Process inbound shipments, inspect receipts, verify vendor deliveries, and update balances.
stockOutDesc: Authorize fulfillment orders, verify on-hand allocation, and dispatch goods with audit tracking.
stocktakingDesc: Conduct periodic physical counts, analyze variance discrepancy, and approve balance reconciliations.
reportsDesc: Analyze historical turnover rates, intake/dispatch velocity, ledger records, and export CSV summaries.
alertsDesc: Monitor critical stock depletion warnings, safety thresholds, and automated reorder signals.
usersDesc: Manage system users, assign role-based permissions, and restrict access scopes per warehouse.
settingsDesc: Configure inventory rules, numbering sequences, timezones, and audit retention policies.
